# Genesis Fixtures

These files are generated by:

```sh
node scripts/genesis-audit.js --download
```

On this Windows workspace, the bundled runner can also be used:

```powershell
.\scripts\run-genesis-audit.ps1 --download
```

The generator downloads Genesis from Sefaria, strips source markup, runs every transliteration style, and writes:

- `source.json`: Hebrew source by chapter and verse.
- `transliterations.json`: generated transliteration snapshots.
- `reports/genesis-irregularities.md`: automatically flagged review items.
- `reports/genesis-review.html`: side-by-side verse review for manual checking.

After fixtures exist, run:

```sh
node tests/genesis-snapshot.test.js
```

The snapshot test compares the current algorithm against the saved Genesis outputs so rule changes show exactly which verses changed.
